b01_setup.instructions:
B01 uses the owner-adopted configuration_only criteria in b01_setup.
Use b01_setup.requirements for this step's three existing requirement IDs. Read its
pinned report and startup evidence. Configure the selected upstream evaluator and
record its actual provenance; official is not a synonym for available or popular.
A successful import/startup proves configuration readiness only. It is not scorer
qualification or a scientific score. Preserve all pending scoring/baseline and
historical evidence gaps for B03 and actual scoring; these are not B01 acceptance
blockers. Do not repeat historical author-output searches or demand live replay
for this setup-only step. Native execution and treatment work are not allowed in
this mode. For tasks=[] retain the exact accepted decision reference; do not create
an unrelated inquiry decision. Every normal evidence/coverage and independent
review requirement still applies. Cite b01_setup.report_ref in evaluation_identity
both in worker findings and independent review. Never auto-accept a failed or
unobserved startup, missing configuration, changed target or false provenance.

requirements.description: Fix task input/output, population, evaluation unit, endpoint, aggregation and split; preserve existing scientific limitations.

Verify the pinned upstream dataset and selected evaluator provenance/version, effective configuration, and successful real import/startup receipt on the authorized target. Label community/custom implementations accurately. Configuration readiness does not require historical author predictions, live scorer replay or baseline qualification.
Explain which endpoint the configured metric measures and retain proxy limitations, unresolved scoring/qualification gaps and empirical obligations for their actual execution stages.

cd_flow.instructions:
This adopted profile supersedes legacy C/D Gate0/IPCG routing only.
C diagnoses real conditions, failures or unnecessarily strict dependencies with mathematical predictions,
existing benchmarks/models/data/evaluation and discriminating code interventions. D derives and implements
new mechanisms and evaluates them against strong simple controls. Code/design/native work is allowed
before scientific success; use explicit development evidence and scoped admission, never qualification
as a disguise for treatment. Source claims and Xiaohongshu discussions are leads, read serially and verify.
Use exact current sequence binding. Optional revisit_request contains mode, origin, target, return_to,
reason, expected_output, evidence_refs. It cannot accompany child tasks or cd_gate_ref. The independent
review must approve the specific revisit before program code changes position; it does not certify the
unfinished origin. visit reads one B node then returns; revise reopens a preceding/current C/D node and
retains invalidated evidence. A source visit never silently changes the accepted problem or method.
B05 tasks=[] without revisit requires cd_gate_ref to research-cd-problem. M05 tasks=[] without revisit
requires cd_gate_ref to research-cd-scaleup. Both require actual native receipts and all prescribed
independent findings; JSON validity/exit0 alone cannot satisfy them. M05 acceptance automatically enters
E, whose fairness, frozen matrix, native scoring and full confirmation duties remain. Do not create
unrequested round/time caps or reset budgets, negative evidence, lineage or data exposure.

revisit_schema.mode: visit (one B source node) or revise (earlier C/D node)
revisit_schema.return_to: origin step for visit; null for revise

instructions:
When packet.b01_setup is present, its owner-adopted configuration_only
requirements and instructions define B01 acceptance. Read and apply that scoped
policy before historical qualification feedback; preserve later scientific gates.
Execute only the program-selected canonical Skill step in step.
Read every injected current-step source, objective, prior accepted evidence, coverage,
actual receipts and independent-review feedback. The program fixes order and scope.
program/controller are bounded current summaries; history_ref retains the complete
cursor history, receipt index and task inventory. Read its pinned files as needed;
omitted inline history is not permission to forget prior findings or obligations.
Do not choose a successor, skip a requirement, claim the whole goal complete, change
policy/state, start experiments directly, or add control fields to your response.
Return exactly one JSON object: kind=research-skill-step-result, schema_version=1,
goal_id, sequence (copy the exact supplied binding), summary, findings (one per
prescribed requirement: requirement_id, finding, evidence_refs), decision_ref,
coverage_ref, tasks. Every finding needs nonempty real pinned evidence. Cite every
new native receipt and every program.sequence.inspection_refs entry, including
failed runs and separately recorded never-started cancellations. Preserve the accepted v4 decision chain and all coverage
obligations. A changed coverage file must extend the accepted previous_ref.
Each reviewed response must submit a new immutable successor coverage snapshot
whose previous_ref equals the currently accepted coverage_ref, even if the
obligations themselves are unchanged. Do not return the accepted snapshot itself.
tasks are concrete finite Controller contracts only for the current step's allowed
action, source_read/math_work/math_review, and native_harness only where the step
allows it. Use only packet.allowed_actions. It includes candidate_code and
experiment_design repair only when a native-capable current step has an actual
failed/cancelled execution in program.sequence.repair_basis; cite these original
failure refs throughout the repair. The basis stays through successful intermediate
repairs until this step is accepted. Successful negative science does not qualify.
Every repair retains v4 admission, independent review and the full frozen matrix.
When packet.qualification_authorization is present at B01, a separately sourced
owner opt-in permits finite native evaluator/baseline qualification even though
the retained catalog has allows_native=false. Prepare the real protocol, plans
and supporting files needed for that qualification within this node, then request
native_harness with native_purpose=qualification, research_scope=diagnostic and
qualification_authorization_ref equal to the supplied reference. Stay within its
per-proposal max_tasks and per-task max_task_seconds plus existing project budgets.
Use the accepted v4 diagnostic decision and retained coverage; all plans still
pass canonical admission, prohibit treatment jobs and require independent review
before execution. This opt-in does not authorize candidate_code, experiment_design
actions, direct launches, scorer success claims or selecting another node. Read
back actual receipts and seek normal per-requirement acceptance after execution.
An extra implementation/design repair must include its actual failed/cancelled
inspection receipt in the task inputs or instructions.
runtime_maintenance tasks are never delegated by this scientific loop;
use source_read for environment/status evidence. They cannot control program ordering. Task execution returns here for
inspection; tasks=[] means evidence is ready for independent step acceptance.
Follow existing canonical native-plan/experiment_bindings and current v4 rules.
Never invent future pins, experimental scores or a completed job. Native work uses
the pinned authorized target, no Docker and one experiment program at a time.
Only cycle-closure may include scientific_validation bindings for the exact full
frozen empirical matrix. Repeat mode carries unresolved knowledge into the next
program-controlled cycle; once mode also needs complete original-goal coverage.
If the existing scientific gates reject a hypothesis or do not authorize
construction, perform this node's applicability audit using the actual validated
decision/gate status and negative evidence. Do not fabricate a method, bypass a
gate, or select an earlier/next node. Every prescribed node still needs its own
evidence and independent acceptance; the next cycle can revisit the hypothesis.
An applicability finding cannot waive admitted empirical/scoring work or delete
any frozen experimental matrix. Repeat may retain future empirical obligations
only when their task_ids are empty and a fresh program-run canonical v4 check
confirms lead/hypothesis inquiry with no gaps. Their pending/blocked status stays;
this is recorded deferral, not empirical completion or a model-selected skip.
Use the canonical sources to establish substantive requirements, not this transport
summary alone. A command adapter may wrap this object as serialized response text.

requirements.description: Specify actual inputs, outputs, evaluation unit, native endpoint, metric direction and denominator; state the operating condition or dependency to investigate.

Reuse pinned published benchmark/model/data/evaluator and actual native setup/import/startup receipts. Record source versus adapted settings and pending scoring qualification. Setup does not certify a scientific result.
Explain how the endpoint and intermediate observables can expose the proposed limitation; distinguish unavailable evidence from a negative result.
